phase_prompt.label: Default / The Collective
phase_prompt.summary: The standard representation of the Sinners as the wealthy, oppressive elite of the simulation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Group shot of the Sinners standing in a formation that suggests power and exclusion. They are dressed in dark, expensive-looking clothing with futuristic textures. The setting is a cold, sterile environment of glass and steel. The lighting is high-contrast, casting long shadows. They look directly at the camera with expressions of disdain. The aesthetic is hyper-realistic and serious.
